CheckTitle: Check if SageMaker Studio domain is configured with VPC-only network access
Description: Check if SageMaker Studio domain is configured with VPC-only network access to prevent direct internet access.
Risk: Without VPC-only access, SageMaker Studio users can access the internet directly, potentially exposing sensitive data or allowing unauthorized data exfiltration.

Recommendation.Text: Configure SageMaker Studio domain with VPC-only network access type to ensure all traffic is routed through your VPC.
